title: WildBench: Benchmarking LLMs with Challenging Tasks from Real Users in the Wild
authors_zh: Bill Yuchen Lin、Yuntian Deng、Khyathi Chandu、Faeze Brahman、Abhilasha Ravichander、Valentina Pyatkin、Nouha Dziri、Ronan Le Bras、Yejin Choi

one_line: WildBench curates hard real-user tasks and applies task-specific checklists for automatic, interpretable model comparison.

title: Problem
问题
html: Static academic benchmarks are often researcher-authored, structurally regular, limited in coverage, and potentially leaked into model training. Chatbot Arena captures real human preferences but depends on continuous online traffic and is difficult to reproduce or diagnose finely. WildBench asks whether challenging, diverse, and publicly evaluable user tasks can be selected from large-scale real chat logs and paired with an automatic evaluation protocol that balances open-ended quality, task-specific requirements, and length-bias control. It aims to measure not standardized test knowledge but a model’s ability to answer realistic, ambiguous, long-tail, and complex user requests.

静态学术 benchmark 往往由研究者编题，任务形式规整、覆盖有限，并可能在模型训练中泄漏；Chatbot Arena 虽来自真人偏好，却依赖持续在线流量，难以复现和进行细粒度诊断。WildBench 研究能否从大规模真实聊天日志中筛选出困难、多样且可公开评测的用户任务，并设计一个同时兼顾开放式质量、任务专属要求和长度偏差控制的自动评价协议。它要测量的不是标准考试知识，而是模型面对真实、含糊、长尾和复杂用户请求时的综合响应能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: WildBench selects 1,024 challenging tasks from more than one million real-user chat records and creates a task-specific checklist for each item. It provides two complementary metrics: WB-Reward compares candidate responses pairwise against baselines, while WB-Score performs pointwise checklist-based scoring. Multiple reference baselines and length-bias mitigation are also introduced. The data combines real prompts, task requirements, candidate responses, baseline responses, and scoring criteria for open-ended model evaluation, judge calibration, and difficult-instruction mining. Its goal is to preserve the difficulty of live user distributions within a reproducible offline benchmark.

WildBench 从超过一百万条真实用户聊天记录中筛选 1,024 个具有挑战性的任务，并为每题制定 task-specific checklist。作者提供两种互补指标：WB-Reward 将候选回答与基线做成成对比较，WB-Score 则按 checklist 进行点式评分；同时引入多个参考基线和长度偏差缓解策略。数据把真实提示、任务要求、候选回答、基线回答及评分标准组织在一起，可用于开放式模型评测、judge 校准和困难指令数据挖掘。其目标是在可重复的离线 benchmark 中保留在线真实用户分布的难度。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Log filtering: More than one million anonymized real chat records are filtered to remove low-quality, sensitive, or unevaluable tasks while retaining difficult and diverse candidates.
  1. Task finalization: Clustering, quality checks, and human review select 1,024 representative user requests spanning multiple open-ended capabilities.
  1. Criterion construction: A task-specific checklist defines factual, reasoning, formatting, or stylistic requirements for each item.
  1. Baseline generation: Responses from several fixed models provide stable anchors for relative comparison.
  1. Dual-metric scoring: WB-Reward performs candidate–baseline pairwise judgment, whereas WB-Score checks individual criteria and aggregates them while mitigating response-length bias.

Reproducibility information: The official data, code, and leaderboard are public, although the complete sampling distribution of private user logs cannot be reproduced for privacy reasons.

1. 日志筛选：从超过一百万条匿名真实聊天记录中去除低质量、敏感和不可评任务，保留高难与多样候选。
  1. 任务定稿：通过聚类、质量检查和人工审核选出 1,024 个代表性用户请求，覆盖多种开放式能力。
  1. 标准构造：为每题编写 task-specific checklist，明确回答必须满足的事实、推理、格式或风格要求。
  1. 基线生成：准备多个固定模型的基线回答，形成稳定的相对比较锚点。
  1. 双指标评分：WB-Reward 进行候选—基线成对判断；WB-Score 逐项检查并聚合，同时校正回答长度带来的偏差。

可复现信息：官方公开数据、代码和榜单；真实日志的完整采样分布因隐私原因无法全部复现。

title: Evidence
证据
html: WildBench model rankings align closely with Chatbot Arena: WB-Reward reaches a correlation of about 0.98 with Arena rankings, while WB-Score reaches about 0.95. This indicates that offline automatic evaluation can reproduce live human preferences reasonably well. The paper also analyzes judges, baseline choices, and length-control strategies, showing that task-specific checklists and multi-baseline comparison improve stability and reduce rewards for verbosity alone. These findings support WildBench as a proxy for real-user capability, although the reported correlations apply mainly to the evaluated model set and should be revalidated for new models, non-English users, and later time periods.

WildBench 的模型排序与 Chatbot Arena 高度一致：WB-Reward 与 Arena 的相关性约为 0.98，WB-Score 约为 0.95，说明离线自动评价能较好复现真人竞技场偏好。论文还分析了不同 judge、基线选择和长度控制策略，显示 task-specific checklist 与多基线比较可提升稳定性，并减少仅因回答更长而获高分的问题。这些证据支持其作为真实用户能力代理指标，但高相关性主要在当时被测模型集合上成立；新模型、非英文用户和不同时间段仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Open-ended evaluations such as AlpacaEval and MT-Bench generally use researcher-designed prompts and uniform judge rules, whereas Arena relies on uncontrolled online pairwise voting. WildBench combines these paradigms: tasks come from real-user logs but are curated into a fixed and reproducible offline set; evaluation uses both model comparison and task-specific checklists with multiple baseline anchors. It also explicitly addresses verbosity bias. The novelty is not the first use of real prompts or LLM judges, but the integration of difficult real-task selection, instance-specific criteria, pairwise and pointwise metrics, and length calibration into an auditable protocol.

AlpacaEval、MT-Bench 等开放式评测通常使用研究者设计的提示和统一 judge 规则，Arena 则依赖不可控的在线两两投票。WildBench 将两者结合：任务来自真实用户日志，但被整理成固定、可复现的离线集合；评价既使用模型对比，也加入每题专属 checklist 和多个基线锚点。它还显式处理长回答偏置。新意不是首次使用真人提示或 LLM judge，而是把真实难题筛选、实例标准、成对与点式指标、长度校准整合为一套可审计评测协议。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Privacy-filtering bias: Removing sensitive or personalized requests for public release changes the real-user distribution.
  1. Static snapshot: The 1,024 tasks represent one period and may saturate as user needs and frontier-model capabilities change.
  1. Judge bias: Checklists and multiple baselines reduce but do not eliminate self-preference, wording, or model-family bias.
  1. Open-ended criteria: Some tasks have many valid answers, and fixed checklists may miss creative but effective solutions.
  1. Language coverage: The dataset is primarily English and does not directly represent Chinese, multilingual, or specialized professional users.

The task pool should be refreshed and periodically recalibrated against human preferences.

1. 隐私筛选偏差：为了公开数据而删除敏感或个人化请求，会改变真实用户分布。
  1. 静态性：1,024 个任务是特定时期快照，用户需求和前沿模型能力变化后可能饱和。
  1. Judge 偏差：checklist 与多基线降低但不能消除自偏好、措辞和模型家族偏差。
  1. 开放式标准：某些任务存在多种合理答案，固定 checklist 可能漏掉创新但有效的解决方案。
  1. 语言覆盖：数据主要面向英文，不能直接代表中文、多语或特定专业用户。

使用时应更新任务池并定期与真人偏好重新校准。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. General model evaluation: Compare model versions on fixed real-user tasks while reporting WB-Reward, WB-Score, and category-level results.
  1. Judge calibration: Use Arena preferences, baseline responses, and checklists to test evaluator ranking ability and verbosity bias.
  1. Difficult-data mining: Extract long-tail instructions from failures and construct correction demonstrations, preference pairs, or instance-level rubric data.
  1. Product regression: Convert tasks into pre-deployment user-scenario tests to diagnose factuality, reasoning, writing, and constraint-following issues. Dedicated benchmarks remain necessary for safety, tool execution, or expert-domain tasks.

1. 通用模型评测：以固定真实用户任务比较模型版本，并同时报告 WB-Reward、WB-Score 和类别结果。
  1. Judge 校准：使用 Arena 偏好、基线回答和 checklist 检查评价模型的排序能力与长度偏差。
  1. 困难数据挖掘：从失败任务提取长尾指令，生成纠错示范、偏好对或实例 rubric 训练数据。
  1. 产品回归：将任务改造成上线前的用户场景测试，定位事实性、推理、写作和约束遵循问题。对于安全、工具执行或领域专家任务，仍需配套专门 benchmark。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: WildBench compresses more than one million real chat logs into 1,024 difficult and reproducible open-ended evaluation tasks.
  1. Data object: Real prompts, task-specific checklists, candidate and multiple baseline responses, and pairwise and pointwise scores.
  1. Metric design: WB-Reward performs relative comparison, while WB-Score performs item-level absolute evaluation with explicit length-bias control.
  1. Evidence anchor: The two metrics correlate with Chatbot Arena rankings at approximately 0.98 and 0.95, respectively.
  1. Main risk: A static English dataset and automatic judges cannot permanently or completely represent real-user distributions.

1. 一句话定位：WildBench 把百万级真实聊天日志压缩为 1,024 个困难、可复现的开放式评测任务。
  1. 数据对象：真实提示、任务专属 checklist、候选与多基线回答，以及成对和点式评分记录。
  1. 指标设计：WB-Reward 做相对比较，WB-Score 做逐项绝对评价，并显式控制长度偏差。
  1. 证据锚点：两种指标与 Chatbot Arena 排名相关性分别约为 0.98 和 0.95。
  1. 主要风险：静态英文样本与自动 judge 无法长期、完整代表真实用户分布。
